notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) worked for robots.txt and the homepage (full SSR mega-menu, 1MB HTML), but individual category/listing pages returned only a client-rendered app shell (Angular Universal SPA, magento backend + searchspring catalog) with no product grid or count in the raw HTML - escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless (chromium, domcontentloaded + explicit scroll to trigger lazy-loaded product grid/count) for every category page; this worked cleanly, no bot-block encountered on either tier, robots.txt has no anthropic/Claude disallow (tier c was not needed). TREE: built from the union of the homepage mega-menu (Accessories > Soft Furnishings, Accessories > Rugs, top-level Storage dropdown) plus each parent page's own tile/sub-nav strip rendered in the browser (this surfaced Rugs children not present in the mega-menu: Cream & Beige, Wool, Round, Jute, in addition to mega-menu's Plain/Patterned). Site is primarily a furniture retailer; no curtains/blinds/table-linen/kitchen-textile/bath-textile categories exist anywhere in the nav or sitemap search (checked with case-insensitive text search across full homepage HTML - zero matches for curtain/blind/napkin/tablecloth/towel/bath mat/shower curtain). QTY: read from each rendered leaf page's own 'N Products' header, cross-confirmed against the lazy-loaded 'You've viewed X of X products' footer text where the category was small enough to fully load (patterned rugs only partially lazy-loaded on one scroll - 107 of 144 - so the explicit '144 Products' header count was used, not the partial viewed count). EXCLUDED: /hallway-furniture (console tables, benches, accent chairs - Furniture, not Storage/Textile, despite page subtitle 'Hallway Furniture & Storage'); material/colour cross-sell link blocks appearing at the foot of every Storage leaf page (e.g. 'Wooden Bookcases', 'White/Black/Grey/Wooden/Oak/Reclaimed/Round Bedside Tables', 'Wooden/Reclaimed/Glass Sideboards', 'Reclaimed Filing Cabinets') - these are SEO related-link widgets, not genuine sub-nav (only /storage/bookcases/wood was spot-checked and confirmed to be a filtered subset of the parent Bookcases count, not a distinct nav node); /accessories/soft-furnishings/mattress-protectors (linked from the Duvets page's cross-sell block but the slug 404s - 'Oops! could not find the page'); all Sofas/Chairs/Tables/Bed Frames/Mattresses/Headboards/Garden Furniture/Office Furniture/brand pages (Furniture, out of scope); Accessories > Mirrors, Art Gallery, Clocks, Bowls, Candle Holders, Candle Lanterns, Trays, Pots & Planters, Artificial Plants, Lighting (Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor / Lighting, not Textile or Storage); Accessories > Rugs itself (/accessories/rugs) and Accessories > Soft Furnishings itself (/accessories/soft-furnishings) are pure landing/group pages with no product listing of their own, only child-category tiles, so only their children carry qty/link per the parent-category-URL rule; the top-level /storage page is likewise a group page (35 shown is a mixed aggregate across all storage subcategories, not a standalone total) so it was recorded as a grouping row only, not as a leaf with its own qty/link. Storage furniture (wardrobes, chest of drawers, bedside tables, sideboards, TV units, bookcases, display cabinets, drinks cabinets & trolleys, filing cabinets, blanket boxes, baskets & trunks) was classified Storage per storage.md SS21/27 because the site's own top-level nav category explicitly names this entire group 'Storage' (not 'Bedroom Furniture' or 'Living Room Furniture').
